target_customer: Organizers of group events such as weddings, conferences and corporate trips who need blocks of hotel rooms
problem: Booking hotel room blocks was done by phone, negotiation and faxed signature pages. Roomblocker offered a survey, a concierge, a dashboard and an online reservation page for guests.
business_model: Marketplace; free to groups, commission paid by hotels

founders.name: Dave Yen
founders.background_notes: Later GP at Orange Collective per YC page.

exit.reason: No company statement found. Crunchbase lists the company as closed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A booking and reservation site is standard web engineering. The hard part was operations, negotiating with hotels, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Hotel relationships were negotiated one by one and the product was copyable. A third party summary says manual negotiation did not scale, which is unverified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cvent offers Passkey room block management today. No dated source shows it acting against Roomblocker.

market_need_then: The company claimed group bookings are a 137 billion dollar worldwide market and that 25 percent of hotel reservations belong to a room block, per TechCrunch. Early customers included Salesforce and Dropbox.

branding.name_origin: Combines room block, the industry term, with a suffix, so the name is the product category.
branding.community_and_virality: Hunted on Product Hunt in July 2015 and covered at YC launch by TechCrunch.

brand_strength.rationale: A clear descriptive name but no brand assets, community or later press were found.

outcome_analysis: Roomblocker launched out of YC S15 with a commission model on group hotel bookings and early corporate customers. Crunchbase lists a closure on 2017-07-14 and the company gave no public reason. A third party aggregator attributes the end to manual hotel negotiation that did not scale, but that is unverified, so the cause is not confirmed and the other code is used only because no listed code fits an unstated cause.
